materializationContract.onArrival: Drop bytes as served, fill sourcePath, sha256, retrievalTimestamp, sectionPointer, verbatimOperativeSpan, sourceCurrentness, verifiedOperativeAuthority and supportsProposedRelationship on the subject, set resolution to 'materialized', and run scripts/verify-rcap-final-official-sources.mjs — it hash-verifies the bytes, requires the cited section and the verbatim span to be present in them, and refuses any non-official host as final authority.
